text:
maria: Quick kickoff — Artemis EAP hardware arrived in the lab and NDA is signed on both sides. Goal this week: run our standard inference benchmarks, collect telemetry, and close the first feedback loop.
artemis_pm: Hi all — confirmed. Signed NDA uploaded to the shared drive (artemis/nda_signed.pdf). We've provisioned 4 nodes (Artemis A1 equiv) behind a jumpbox. I'll DM creds via Vault.
alex: Awesome. Can Artemis share the baseline run outputs (p50/p95, power draw, and a short-stats CSV)? Even rough numbers help.
artemis_pm: Baseline CSV coming in ~30m. Quick preview: p50 ~56ms (seq512,batch4) on their tuning image. Will post link.
prateek: For reproducibility, please use our harness:
```bash
rwi-bench run --model redwood-open-3b --seq 1024 --batch 4 --iters 100 --kv-cache --output results/artemis/run1.json```
prateek: Also include kernel env: KERNEL_HINT=artemis_fast and set QUANT=bf16 for parity with hosted runs.
ellie: Timeline check — can we have initial runs and telemetry ingestion in 48 hours? We'd like to spot any regressed ops early.
artemis_pm: Wed EOD is doable. I'll enable telemetry shipper to the sandbox S3 bucket you provide. Need an IAM role/creds with write-only to bucket/artemis-eap/* and SNS topic to notify on upload.
maria: I'll open a ticket with the exact IAM policy and SOW retention window. @tae can you provision the bucket and short-lived creds?
tae: On it. I'll create the bucket (redwood-eap/artemis) and a temp IAM role. Will post credential rotation schedule in the ticket.
hw-ci-bot: CI:benchmark-run #231 triggered by prateek/bench-updates. Status: queued :hourglass_flowing_sand:
prateek: One more: include these perf probes in the run so we can correlate kernel clocks with latency spikes: /opt/telemetry/probes/artemis_cpu.json and power draw sampling at 250ms.
alex: Also please capture nvidia-like telemetry equivalents (SMI counters, temp, power) and a host-level perf top for the sample windows.
artemis_pm: We'll expose SMI-compatible counters and install the host-perf agent. Note: we have a microcode parameter that may change perf by ~3-7% — we'll tag runs with microcode_version in metadata.
maria: Important: NDA clause 4.2 — raw telemetry must be purged after 90 days. We'll set S3 lifecycle and mention this in the SOW.
ellie: Can we schedule a 30m sync after the first successful run to review numbers and prioritize any tuning? I'll send a calendar invite.
prateek: Action items (short):
- prateek: push bench config + dockerfile to GH (branch: artemis/eap)
- tae: provision S3 bucket + temp creds + lifecycle policy
- maria: finalize SOW + confirm NDA retention clause
- artemis_pm: upload baseline CSV, enable telemetry shipper, DM creds to Vault
- alex: prepare perf probes checklist and post to the ticket

artemis_pm: Confirmed. We'll also provide 2 sample workloads that mirror customer production: chat-stream (seq=512) and long-completion (seq=2048).
maria: Great. Please include exact image tags for the nodes and sha256 of the runtime. We'll pin in the bench config.
prateek: Note for the harness: when you run, include `--tags microcode_version=<ver> runtime_sha=<sha256>` so results get indexed correctly.
tae: Uploaded initial IAM draft to the ticket and posted a link to the vault path where I'll put creds.
artemis_pm: Baseline CSV: https://artemis.share/baselines/artemis_initial.csv (internal). Posting short summary: p50=55.8ms, p95=76ms, power_avg=310W (node).
ellie: Nice. If initial runs are close, we'll move to a small regression sweep (quantization + batching) next week.
maria: Thanks team — tagging with #eap #artemis. Please keep updates in this thread so we have a single source of truth. :thumbsup:
